steps.content: Once outside the dressing room, they walk in silence down the corridor, one behind the other. The man is the ship's bartender, <color=#fb9259>Cassian</color>. They've never spoken before, but his voice sounds familiar... like the one who reminded her to watch for the signal before the show.
Cassian's face is expressionless. It's impossible to tell if he's dejected, melancholic, or just plain cold.
Did he just help me? Should I thank him?

Sallie can't figure out his motives for stepping in. Is it a sense of justice? Or does he have ulterior motives? The stress makes it hard to think. Before she can work it out, they reach a fork in the corridor.

Cassian stops. He gives a slight bow, as if to say goodbye, then turns back toward the bar without another word. Sallie stands there alone, feeling like an idiot. The words of gratitude die on her lips.
...Tch. He was just running an errand. Do I have to grovel for that? Stop acting so cheap, Sallie. That's why they walk all over you.
She looks down the other end of the hallway. Mr. E's office is not far away.
She's heard that he's the true owner of Euphoria. All the staff answer to him, and VIP guests need his invitation to board. Yet since arriving, Sallie has never once met her boss.
She takes a deep breath and knocks.

The dim ambient lighting barely penetrates the darkness. Only a massive, floor-to-ceiling window reveals the contents of the room: a desk nearly two meters long, a leather swivel chair positioned to overlook the bar and dance floor.

A projection on the desk displays surveillance feeds from the entire ship. The faint glow illuminates a row of small figurines on the desk, about a dozen of them, their features indistinct. On the wall nearby, the light from the window traces the outline of a relief model of Euphoria.
Sallie's eyes haven't adjusted to the darkness. It's only when one of the small figurines topples with a clatter that she sees the hand that pushed it and hears a low voice from the shadows.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Who is it?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...Sallie, the new dancer. Cassian told me to come see you.
Her introduction is met first with a low chuckle, then the sound of the leather chair turning.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: A new face... What's your M-value? Your ability?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...What? M... value?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I'm a dancer. Dancing is obviously what I do best. Isn't that what you hired me for?
She pulls her shoulders back, though she can't keep the tremor out of her voice.

After a short silence, she sees the hand swipe across the screen, switching the surveillance feed to text records. Sallie can't make out what it says, but for the first time, she catches a glimpse of his face in the glow.
Refined, delicate, cold, and pale, like wax rather than flesh. He glances down for only a second, the cold glow touching his eyes fleetingly before dying out.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: ...That works, I suppose. Cheap, and lacks the ability to cause trouble.
He doesn't look at Sallie again. He picks up one of the figurines, toying with it out of boredom, or perhaps contemplation. A long silence ensues.
No questions, no reproach, not even another glance her way, as if she weren't there at all. The silence and the darkness grow suffocating.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: So why did you... send for me?

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: ...Send for you? Who did?
Sallie freezes, then her face flushes red.
That bartender... he was messing with me?!

Her hands tremble with rage. The relief she'd felt at being pulled away from the mob backstage is long gone, replaced by the shame and fury of being tricked. Sallie spins around, ready to storm out, grab that gloomy hypocrite, and punch him in his deadpan face.
Everyone thinks they can screw with me, everyone looks down on me. What gives you the right?! I'm not one of your—
Bang!
The door is flung open, the light from the corridor spilling into the dark room. A brilliant flash of gold darts in as a sugary voice cuts through the silence.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh my God! Mr. E, you have to hear this!
The little golden doll comes clicking in on high heels. It's... Milly? She flits over to the desk, deftly spinning Mr. E's chair around and throwing her arms around his neck.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I had the most wonderful chat with Mr. Lucian today! And did you know? He's such a sweetheart! He was so shy when he talked about his first love, even his ears turned red!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: And! Most importantly, that kind, devoted gentleman... he told me something about him! Awww!
steps.female_content: And! Most importantly, that kind, devoted gentleman... he told me something about her! Awww!

steps.content: Milly squeals, cupping her face and bouncing in excitement. Sallie can almost see ditzy bubbles popping over her head.
Mr. E smiles. Light falls on his face, and Sallie can see clearly that his previous coldness is gone. He gently takes Milly's hand and pats it a couple times, his eyes filled with doting affection.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Because you're Euphoria's renowned jewel. They all adore you. Of course they're eager to talk to you.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Does that mean I'm famous? Has everyone in DisCity heard my name? Am I a big star now?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Has my love heard about me too?
Mr. E's smile deepens.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: If he'd heard, don't you think he'd come running to see you? So, not quite yet. Keep up the good work. Spend more time with our honored guests. Make yourself unforgettable, so they'll carry your name back to DisCity. Sooner or later, your love is bound to hear of you.
steps.female_content: If she'd heard, don't you think she'd come running to see you? So, not quite yet. Keep up the good work. Spend more time with our honored guests. Make yourself unforgettable, so they'll carry your name back to DisCity. Sooner or later, your love is bound to hear of you.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Such a moving legend, such sincere devotion... How could he possibly resist the urge to come and see you? So when that day comes, you must make yourself beautiful and charming enough, for him.
steps.female_content: Such a moving legend, such sincere devotion... How could she possibly resist the urge to come and see you? So when that day comes, you must make yourself beautiful and charming enough, for her.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Go get a spa treatment, Milly. Pamper yourself, especially that gorgeous blonde hair. He'll crave you, like a bee attracted to nectar.
steps.female_content: Go get a spa treatment, Milly. Pamper yourself, especially that gorgeous blonde hair. She'll crave you, like a bee attracted to nectar.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Really? When? In a day? A week... a month? Oh my, there's no time!

The man speaks in honeyed tones while the woman listens with ecstatic joy. The only outsider stands in the shadows, feeling so disgusted she could almost vomit. Good thing Sallie hasn't eaten all day, so she's spared that humiliation.
What a load of crap. You don't even have an audience. Who are you trying to fool? I'm so sick of this...
She turns to leave, but just as she steps into the light, she hears a soft cry from behind her.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh, you have another guest? Hmm, you're...
Milly hurries toward Sallie, her curious gaze lingering on her.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I know you! You're the one who fell on stage today!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh my goodness, your knees are scraped! And your foot, does it hurt? Are you hurt anywhere else?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Wait... you're not a Sinner?

Of course she has to bring up the one thing Sallie wants to forget. Her face flushes a deeper red, and she jerks her hand away from Milly's grasp. She opens her mouth to speak, but the man cuts her off.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Not a Sinner, but quite charming nonetheless, don't you think? With the recent departures leaving us short-staffed, we've recruited some exceptional ordinary people to bring a little novelty to the show.
He looks at Sallie again, smiling for the first time.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Now I remember. It was you... A very interesting debut. That creative little tumble was quite eye-catching. Some guests have already requested you by name. Congratulations.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Requested me?!

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Yes, by name. Don't worry. For someone in your position, this is a very good job. A little dancing on stage, a little chatting off stage... All you have to do is keep the guests happy.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Keep them satisfied, win their affection, and those distinguished patrons will reward you handsomely—with clothes, fine food, tips, and all the love you could want... Oh, you have the perfect example right here.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Go on, Milly. Show the rookie the ropes, as the Jewel of Euphoria. Teach her how to work, help her love the life here. We can't have her being so anxious all the time. It spoils the fun for the guests.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh, of course! Poor thing, she looks absolutely terrified. Leave it to me.
Milly's smile, radiant and sincere, only fills Sallie with dread. She takes two steps back.
Can't she understand what he's really saying? Doesn't she know what kind of place this is? Why is this idiot grinning like a fool? What does she want to teach me?!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: No... If you want me to... do those things with them... I'd rather die!
Sensing Sallie's distress, Milly gives her a consoling smile, gently taking her arm and trying to calm her down.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's not that bad! We're all human. As long as you love them the right way, everyone can be happy. I'll show you how.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Do you have any idea what you're saying?!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Well, what I mean is...
Mr. E is no longer looking at the two dancers. He idly fiddles with the projection, watching every corner of Euphoria in the surveillance feeds. He speaks with a casual smile.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Take your time, Milly. You can do it. There's only one reason Sallie resists our guests so much...

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Perhaps she already has someone special. A lover she's pining for on the outside.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Huh?
Milly gasps, forgetting she'd just been shoved away. Her eyes shine even brighter, her face glowing with surprise and joy.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You... have someone special, too?

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: NO I DON'T!
Sallie can't stand it anymore. Her voice is almost a shriek.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What the hell?! I don't give a damn about your crap or your fake-ass high society! Leave me alone!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Get those agents to take me back! So what if it's a loan shark? I'll go and pay it off! I'll pay millions, even billions! I'll sell whatever I have on the dark web and pay up! I'm done working here!

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: You're all bastards... The guests, the Jewel, everything on this damn ship is filthy as hell! Stay away from me!
Before Milly can answer, Sallie turns and storms out of the door. She runs straight into someone...
It's Cassian, carrying a bottle of red wine. He seems surprised to see Sallie burst out of the office, but gets cut off before he can speak.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: This is all your fault! You lying bastard! Don't let me see you again! Get out of my way!
The bristling stray cat hisses and stomps away, leaving Cassian standing in the hallway. The office door cracks open, and a small, golden head peeks out.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hmm, sounds like a rough relationship.
She cocks her head, gives Cassian an apologetic look, and adds:

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't mind her, Cassian. It's not your fault. When people get mad, they'll kick any dog that crosses their path.
The bartender shrugs. He doesn't seem to care, but he uses the opportunity to glance past Milly...

In the shadows of the long desk, Mr. E is smiling as he sweeps his hand across the projection. The surveillance switches to a different feed. It's somewhere in the WhiteSands, the coordinates unclear. But something unusual in the blurry image has captured his full attention...

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: You want to leave? Hehe...
Mr. E looks up, and Cassian quickly averts his gaze. He hands the tray to Milly, bows lightly, and turns to walk away.
At the same moment, the new dancer is stomping down the other end of the corridor, the floorboards shuddering with her barely contained rage.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Bastards... all of them...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I'm getting out of this goddamned place! Just you wait... I will...
